# telnyx_messaging_rcs_capability (Data Source)

The RCS features a recipient phone number supports for an RCS agent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) RCS agent ID
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number

### Read-Only

- `agent_name` (String) RCS agent name
- `features` (List of String) List of RCS capabilities
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource
